### 🟡 Changes recommended The fallback still exposes flat/default configuration through `otelProperties` in an enabled declarative context.
1 open issue - [Disable fallback config bean in declarative mode](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20771#discussion_r4328990051) · New
What changed in this PR Removes deprecated declarative-to-flat configuration compatibility while preserving the flat-to-declarative bridge and flat-property Spring configuration. **Changes:** - Removes the reverse bridge, its tests, and unused dependencies. - Removes the declarative Spring compatibility bean and updates configuration tests. - Updates documentation and breaking-change notes. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | instrumentation/​spring/​spring-boot-autoconfigure/​src/​testDeclarativeConfig/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​spring/​autoconfigure/​DeclarativeConfigTest.java | Reads configuration through `ConfigProvider`. | | instrumentation/​spring/​spring-boot-autoconfigure/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​spring/​autoconfigure/​OpenTelemetryAutoConfiguration.java | Removes declarative compatibility bean. | | declarative-config-bridge/​src/​test/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​config/​bridge/​DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridgeTest.java | Deletes reverse-bridge tests. | | declarative-config-bridge/​src/​test/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​config/​bridge/​DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridgeBuilderTest.java | Deletes builder tests. | | declarative-config-bridge/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​config/​bridge/​DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridgeBuilder.java | Deletes deprecated builder. | | declarative-config-bridge/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​config/​bridge/​DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridge.java | Deletes reverse-bridge implementation. | | declarative-config-bridge/​README.md | Describes the remaining bridge. | | declarative-config-bridge/​build.gradle.kts | Removes unused dependencies. | | CHANGELOG.md | Records removals and migration guidance. |
Review effort: Balanced

[Config] Removing this bean makes `FallbackConfigProperties` eligible in an enabled declarative context: it requires an `OpenTelemetry` bean and no `ConfigProperties` bean, but does not exclude declarative mode. It therefore recreates `otelProperties` using `DefaultConfigProperties`, so existing consumers silently read flat/default values instead of the active YAML. Add `@Conditional(DeclarativeConfigDisabled.class)` to the fallback so the compatibility bean is actually removed in declarative mode while remaining available for flat configuration.

Remove the deprecated declarative-to-flat bridge and declarative Spring Boot `ConfigProperties` compatibility bean. The supported flat-to-declarative bridge and flat-property Spring configuration remain available.

- **Declarative configuration:** Read settings through `ConfigProvider` and `DeclarativeConfigProperties`:
  ```java
  DeclarativeConfigProperties javaConfig =
      configProvider.getInstrumentationConfig().getStructured("java");
  ```
- **Flat-property configuration:** Continue using the Spring `ConfigProperties` bean.
